mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, the weather is overcast with a temperature of 82 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. Under the full moon tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 66 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city has two important updates for homeowners. First, a road surface treatment project kicks off August 4, starting on Lincoln Street, so look out for no-parking signs tomorrow. Additionally, the city offers rebates for both high-efficiency toilets and rain barrels to help with water conservation.

There is plenty to do in our community, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia, all happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard tomorrow.
Looking at the police report from last week, on July 26, an officer responded to a hit-and-run collision near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, resulting in a citation for the driver.
Enjoy the Caramel Turtle flavor at Culver's, open until 10 PM tonight. You can also catch Kona Ice today at Fireman's Park from 12:30 PM to 4:30 PM and at McGaw Park from 4:30 PM to 7 PM.
